
{{alias}}( din )
    Tests a double-precision floating-point numeric value for NaN.

    Parameters
    ----------
    din: number
        Double-precision floating-point number to test.

    Returns
    -------
    bool: boolean
        Boolean indicating whether the value is NaN.

    Examples
    --------
    > var bool = {{alias}}( NaN )
    true
    > bool = {{alias}}( 5.0 )
    false

    See Also
    --------
